UADx 1176 FET Compressor.note: Native emulation of the classic 1176 FET compressor/limiter.

UADx 610-A Preamp and EQ.note: Emulation of UA's vintage 610-A tube preamp and EQ.

UADx 610-B Preamp and EQ.note: Emulation of UA's later 610-B tube preamp and EQ.

UADx Century Tube Channel Strip.note: Vintage German tube preamp and EQ channel strip emulation.

UADx Galaxy Tape Echo.note: Emulation of the Roland RE-201 Space Echo tape delay.

UADx Oxide Tape Recorder.note: Streamlined analogue tape machine emulation for warmth and saturation.

UADx PolyMAX Synth.note: Polyphonic analogue-modelled synthesizer inspired by classic 1980s polysynths.

UADx Pure Plate Reverb.note: Simple plate reverb modelled on a vintage EMT 140.

UADx Showtime 64 Tube Amp.note: Emulation of a 1964 blackface-era tube guitar amplifier.

UADx Verve Analog Machines.note: Ten tape and preamp saturation machines; since renamed Vibe Analog Machines.

UADx Vibe Analog Machines Essentials.note: Cut-down edition of Vibe Analog Machines retro saturation plugin.

2RuleSynthV-3-1.note: Free experimental subtractive synthesizer with matrix modulation and effects.

TugGlicento.note: Trigger-matrix multi-effect that plays several glitch effects simultaneously.

TugImgSynth.note: Wavetable synthesizer that builds wavetables from dropped-in images.

TugMidiSeq.note: Polyphonic MIDI arpeggiator and step sequencer driven by held chords.

TugMultiEffect.note: Freely routable multi-effect with eleven drag-and-drop effect blocks.

TugPhonon.note: Rotating magnetic-disc tape delay with eight heads and resonators.

TugSpect.note: FFT spectral filter that shapes audio from image pixel values.

Chopa.note: Free chopper/vibrato effect adding rhythmic movement to any source.

DrGate.note: Drum-specific noise gate plugin from Analog Obsession.

RazorClip.note: Analogue-modelled clipper with tape, transformer, BJT, tube and diode modes.

ReLife.note: Saturation and dynamic EQ enhancer for reviving lifeless tracks.

Lounge Lizard Session 4.note: Cut-down physically modelled electric piano from the Lounge Lizard range.

Strum Session 2.note: Modelled acoustic and electric guitar with strumming and chord recognition.

Ultra Analog Session 2.note: Simplified analogue-modelled synthesizer from the Ultra Analog VA range.

AIR Multiband Filterbank.note: Three-band filter bank with five filter modes and envelope followers.

AIR Tape Double Track.note: Tape-style automatic double-tracking effect for thickening vocals and instruments.

BEAM Filter.note: Free state-variable filter with formant and comb modes, from BEAM.

BEAM Haze.note: Free chorus, phase and dispersion effect with diffusion reverb.

ShinRonin.note: Free modular filter and delay, a rebuild of 2003's Ronin.

FKFX Nanomix.note: Humanizer creating slow micro-variations in level, pan and MIDI.

DC1A3.note: Free two-knob character compressor with negative ratio and saturation.

PitchNet.note: Free open-source vocal tuning editor using neural pitch resynthesis.

SynfulOrchestra.note: Orchestral instrument using Reconstructive Phrase Modeling for expressive solo lines.

ZL Equalizer 2.note: Free open-source parametric equalizer with dynamic bands and matching.
